title: Sunday · the Rain, 2020
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twenty-third January. The last Rain in the public strip. The beach. Nobody. Then tracks. Then the tracks washing out.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach in rain. Nobody. Watercolor softening into slate and ochre — Era IV's palette arriving early.

image.prompt: a Pacific Northwest beach in January rain with nobody on it, watercolor in slate blue and muted ochre, no words

panels.name: Nobody

panels.composition: Tier 2: two sets of tracks in the wet sand — a man's, a three-legged dog's — going up the beach. Nobody making them.
props: tracks: boots and a three-legged gait

image.prompt: close on wet sand with two sets of tracks in the rain, a man's boots and a small three-legged dog's uneven prints, no figures, watercolor, no words
image.notes: Three-legged prints: two front, one hind. Draw them right.

panels.name: Tracks

panels.composition: Tier 3: the tide coming in over the tracks. Half gone. The rain. Held.

image.prompt: the same wet sand with the tide sliding in over two sets of tracks, half of them already gone, rain, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Washing out

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: The last public Rain. The tracks washing out. The 2007 device, ended.
